race.comment: TUDAYA (6) has the most convincing recent profile, with his Hamilton fourth better than the bare result after he was restrained, steadied and still got within a length and a half of Tarakash. His Penola second before that reads well for this grade, and he also holds a recent edge over TURNED LOOSE and BLACK BUGATTI. BACKFLIPS (13) is the obvious danger after a one-length second at Bordertown, having also been beaten only half a length at Mildura the run before, so her current form is sharper than most. TURNED LOOSE (12) was only just behind TUDAYA at Hamilton and has enough 1550m substance to be a genuine threat if she repeats that closing effort. BLACK BUGATTI (15) eases from provincial company after a wide run at Gawler and has been close enough in two recent starts, although his 1550m record makes him more of a risk than the first three selections.
